summary: Full backend + frontend test of ZapDesk. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases passing across auth, agents, contacts, conversations/messages, simulate-incoming with keyword bot trigger, AI suggest (Claude via emergentintegrations), templates, automations, bot/whatsapp settings, calls (with recording upload), dashboard stats, and role gating. Frontend: 16/16 UI scenarios passing via Playwright — admin login, inbox list of 3 seeded conversations, send message, simulate incoming (message count increased), AI suggest fills composer (201 chars generated), toggle bot, navigation across Contacts/Templates/Chatbot/Agents/Analytics/Connection/Calls, attendant login, and role gating (attendant redirected away from /chatbot and /agents).

minor.issue: Response body returns pre-clear snapshot of unread count. Server does update unread=0 in DB, but the returned `conversation` object is fetched before the update, so client sees stale unread on that specific response. Client polling/list refresh masks it in practice.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In GET /api/conversations/{conv_id}, re-fetch conv after update or set conv['unread']=0 in the returned dict to reflect the DB state in the same response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 818-line module holding all routes; consider splitting into routers per resource (auth, agents, contacts, conversations, calls, settings) if it will grow.

Login/registration set httpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookies AND return access_token in body; frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage. Consider consolidating to cookie-only for XSS safety or clarifying strategy.
GET /api/agents is available to any authenticated user and returns all users (including admins). This exposes staff list to attendants — acceptable for helpdesk but worth confirming intended.
POST /api/conversations/{id}/toggle-bot has no admin check; any attendant can toggle bot on any conversation. Likely intended, but flag for review.
Recording upload stores full base64 blob inside MongoDB document with no size limit. For MVP fine, but add server-side max size and consider GridFS/object storage for production.
process_incoming keyword matching is case-insensitive substring match — 'oi' matches 'boi', 'coisa'. Consider word-boundary regex to avoid false positives.

Login attempts lockout window uses fixed 15 minutes and never clears on success unless the same identifier record already existed; logic works but `locked_until` is written on every failure regardless of count — cosmetic. All auth-playbook items verified (bcrypt $2b$, cookies, brute-force lockout, generic forgot response, sha256 token_hash, reset clears lockout, seed_admin updates existing).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified. Frontend flows verified via Playwright including AI suggestion (real Claude call via emergentintegrations returned 201-char reply). Only minor bug found: GET /api/conversations/{id} returns pre-clear unread in that specific response body (fixed in test by re-fetching list). Everything else works.
rca of the issue: N/A — only one minor stale-snapshot issue documented above; no user-visible impact due to list polling.
